[[File:Ice creature.jpg|250px|thumb|An ice creature]]
'''Ice creatures''' were [[Water/Legends|icy]] [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]] that the [[Ice Demon]] [[Stagorr]] had the power to summon. Stagorr once sent two of these creatures to attack [[Logray/Legends|Logray]] on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. The pair were destroyed when Logray turned the snow beneath them to ice, sending the creatures crashing into each other.<ref name="Ewoks 6">[[Ewoks (1985) 6|''Ewoks'' (1985) 6]]</ref>
